In second place, गॉंव में दिवाली मनाने का तरीका🪔, by Thar Desert Photography, with over 441 thousand likes.
And number one: What If Bug-Man Grew Inside Purple Guy 😱, by Zack D. Films, with over 533 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
